example.thai: ช่วยอุ่นให้หน่อยครับ
example.english: Could you please heat this up for me?

words.note: Cashiers will often ask 'อุ่นไหม' (ùn mǎi - 'Heat it up?') when you buy ready-to-eat meals, buns, or toasties.

example.thai: ไม่รับถุงครับ
example.english: I don't need a bag, thanks.

words.note: Thai convenience stores do not automatically provide free plastic bags; say 'mâi ráp thǔng' if you have your own.

example.thai: ขอหลอดด้วยครับ
example.english: May I have a straw as well?

words.note: Straws are usually stored behind the register or dispenser station rather than packed by default.

example.thai: สแกนจ่ายได้ไหมครับ
example.english: Can I pay by scanning QR code?

words.note: Almost all Thai convenience stores and chain shops accept PromptPay or wallet QR codes via 'สแกนจ่าย' (sà-kɛɛn jàai).

example.thai: รับใบเสร็จไหมครับ

words.note: Keep your 7-Eleven receipt if you collect promotional stamp coupons printed at the bottom during promotional campaigns.
